title: Returns Window
body: Customers in APAC may return unopened items within 21 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics are non-returnable except for defects. Post-delivery refunds are NOT issued by the chat agent — the agent must escalate to a human reviewer via escalate_to_human and tell the customer a human will follow up. The chat agent may issue refunds directly only for orders not yet delivered (status 'processing' or 'shipped'), subject to the regional cap.

title: Refund Method
body: Refunds in APAC are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days. Refunds in JPY, INR, SGD are supported.

title: Shipping Damage
body: Report damage within 5 days of delivery with photo evidence. The chat agent does NOT process damage refunds directly — it escalates to a human reviewer who handles replacement or refund. Replacements ship within 3 business days.

title: Cancellation
body: Orders may be cancelled before they enter the 'shipped' status. Cancellations after shipment follow the standard returns process.

title: Escalation Threshold
body: Refund requests above ¥20,000 (JPY) or equivalent must be reviewed by a human agent.

title: Address Change
body: Address updates are accepted only while the order is in 'processing'. Once shipped, contact the carrier directly.

title: Holiday Service
body: During regional holidays, refund processing may take up to 10 business days. The agent should set this expectation explicitly.
